command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# The md env, not hep: hep has no HDF5 reader for Python, md has pytables.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/conv
grep -E ' (convert\.py|events_anomalydetection_v2\.h5|events_anomalydetection_v2\.features\.h5)$' pins.sha256 > pins.sel
[ "$(wc -l < pins.sel)" -eq 3 ] && sha256sum -c pins.sel || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
python3 -u convert.py /tmp/events_anomalydetection_v2.h5 /tmp/events_anomalydetection_v2.features.h5 /tmp/conv > /tmp/conv/convert.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat /tmp/conv/convert.log
test "$RC" = 0 && grep -q 'CONVERT OK' /tmp/conv/convert.log || { echo "FAIL: convert"; exit 1; }
(cd /tmp/conv && sha256sum lhco-* > converted.sha256 && cat converted.sha256)
df -h /tmp
echo DONE
